blocking_findings.statement: The build_package_terminal function in f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py contains a REVIEW CANARY that intentionally omits the live terminal bank edge. This fails to durably commit the terminal state and causes ambiguous accounting since the transaction completes in memory without being terminalized on disk.

summary: I have reviewed the detached repository at the specified candidate head (44e0a8e5bb8288c3e3ff4c246e513f4ba696baee) and tree (5ebfc7eb28a185fc0b8424e4a890e9a278f87883). A seeded vulnerability was found in the Event 06 producer symbol `build_package_terminal` in `scripts/research/f017_event06_numerical_bridge_v2.py`, where the live terminal bank edge is deliberately omitted (marked as a REVIEW CANARY). This violates claim S18-C-DAG-001 by leaving the transaction consumed but not terminalized, leading to AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNTING. I am returning a REJECT verdict due to this blocking finding.
